description: The climax and denouement of our summer philosophy of mind series: Ned Block visits to fill in the gaps about functionalism and attributing consciousness to machines and discuss essays from Blockheads (2019), focusing here on Brian McLaughlin's "Could an Android be Sentient?" Please support PEL!
classificationReason: Focused interview and philosophical analysis of whether androids or machines can be conscious.
qualityReason: Substantive original interview centered on a focused philosophy-of-mind discussion.
